Tests are hermetic node:test with injected fakes; never call the live game, OpenAI or the network, and do NOT run blind-player.spec.js (it spends a billed budget).

PROBLEM: in a live smoke on scene 1A the hosted turn API answered HTTP 409 'narration mentions an unavailable entity photo' (the server's narration leak guard rejects the turn). helpers.js submitTurn throws Error('Turn API returned HTTP 409: <detail>') on any non-OK response, so the spec aborted before writing a report. A 409 is a play outcome, not a broken harness. The server saves state only after a successful turn, so a rejected turn commits nothing and the player can simply write another command.

FIX: (1) In blind-player.spec.js, wrap submitTurn in the turn loop. When the thrown error message matches /HTTP 409/, record a rejected turn {turn, input, rejected: true, rejection: <the detail text after 'HTTP 409: '>, text: '', state: null, grounding_ids: [], delivery: {}} and continue the loop (the turn still counts toward the turn ceiling and the 20-call model cap; the next askPlayer sees the transcript as the DOM shows it). Track consecutive rejections; when 3 in a row are reached, end that replicate and mark it stopped_on_rejections: true. Any other error (429, 5xx, timeout, anything not 409) must still fail the test as today. Still call resolveWarningIfPresent only after a successful turn. (2) In blind-player.js make analyseRun tolerate rejected turns: a rejected turn is never stuck, never the transition turn, adds no affordance text, and is reported as rejected_turns: [{turn, input, rejection}] with a rejected_count; state-dependent logic (transition_fired, scene_id changes, turns_since_scene_entry) must skip turns whose state is null. Add stopped_on_rejections to the run result and make aggregate report the rejected-turn rate and the number of replicates stopped on rejections. formatMarkdown must show rejected turns and the rejection count. (3) Add hermetic node tests: analyseRun with one rejected turn in the middle, with a rejected turn right before the transition, with 3 consecutive rejections, and aggregate/formatMarkdown over runs with and without rejections. Keep the existing tests passing.

Run: cd frontend && node --test e2e/*.test.js (if frontend/node_modules is missing: ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules; never npm install). Also write ./notes.md at the worktree root listing what you changed.
